# ImageCompressionLevel

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

How hard BonniePDF works to shrink the Flate-compressed pixel data of embedded images.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Values

- `Smallest`: The slowest, smallest setting (zlib level 9). Worth it only for a document that is written once and distributed widely, or when every byte of output counts.
- `Balanced`: The default (zlib level 6): roughly a quarter faster than `Smallest` for output that is typically about 1-2% larger.
- `Fast`: The quickest setting (zlib level 1): the fastest to write, with noticeably larger images.
